evidence_quotes: Bij besluit van 25 februari 2015 heeft algemeen bestuur krachtens artikel 5.4 van de Waterwet het projectplan "Hazeldonkse Beek" vastgesteld.
rationale: This Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerns the adoption of a water management project plan ("Hazeldonkse Beek") by the general board (algemeen bestuur) of a regional water authority pursuant to Article 5.4 of the Water Act (Waterwet). It directly involves substantive water governance by a waterboard, with no household connection refusal or informal settlement issue.
